title: Somali and the Forest Spirit
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a world of spirits and monsters where humans were persecuted nearly to extinction, a golem guarding a forest finds a small human girl, Somali, and becomes her protector. With only about a year left to live, he travels with her in disguise looking for other humans, while she calls him Dad.
life_message: Love grows through caring for a child, and family can be found across any difference.

content.note: Humans are a delicacy to monsters; a harpy is willing to kill a human to cure her companion (Wikipedia).
Danger of discovery and a betrayal by an innkeeper (Wikipedia); iyashikei overall (AniList).
Golem's limited lifespan and coming parting; grief themes (MU Limited Lifespan; Wikipedia).
Somali's curiosity leads her into trouble.

folkways.japan: An iyashikei (healing) seinen work, a Japanese genre focused on gentle mood, with oni and yokai-like creatures from Japanese folklore.

delivery.evidence: MU votes Discrimination; Wikipedia plot frames persecution of humans; no review on delivery (to verify).
delivery.note: The theme of prejudice is carried through encounters on the journey, with kind and hostile non-humans alike.

winners_losers: Somali and the golem's bond wins sympathy; the manga was discontinued, so the journey's outcome is unresolved in the manga.
